CACHE_INVALIDATION_CONSUMER_STALLED.name: Cache Invalidation Consumer Stalled
CACHE_INVALIDATION_CONSUMER_STALLED.description: The message queue consumer responsible for processing cache eviction/invalidation events has stalled. Mutations are committed in DB but not invalidated in cache, leading to high stale read rates, cache-miss query cascades, and DB connection pool saturation.

DATABASE_CAPACITY_DEGRADATION.name: Database Capacity Degradation
DATABASE_CAPACITY_DEGRADATION.description: The underlying database engine, CPU, or storage is exhausted or failing under standard query load.

CACHE_NODE_FAILURE.name: Cache Node Hardware / Process Crash
CACHE_NODE_FAILURE.description: Cache cluster nodes are unreachable, dead, or failing health checks.

TRAFFIC_SURGE.name: External Traffic Surge
TRAFFIC_SURGE.description: Unprecedented incoming traffic volume is exceeding capacity at the ingress layer.

DATABASE_INDEX_REGRESSION.name: Database Index Regression
DATABASE_INDEX_REGRESSION.description: A dropped, invalid, or missing query index on critical tables forces full table scans on production queries.

REPLICA_LAG.name: Database Read Replica Lag
REPLICA_LAG.description: Replication stream from database primary to read replicas is delayed.

RECOVER_CONSUMER_AND_DRAIN.name: Restart Invalidation Consumer & Drain Backlog
RECOVER_CONSUMER_AND_DRAIN.description: Restart the stalled queue worker consumer pool and accelerate draining of accumulated cache invalidation events.
RECOVER_CONSUMER_AND_DRAIN.risk_notes: Slight transient message broker load while processing backlogged events; completely safe for persistent storage.
RECOVER_CONSUMER_AND_DRAIN.reversibility: High — consumer workers can be paused or restarted without data mutation loss.
RECOVER_CONSUMER_AND_DRAIN.suggested_command: kubectl rollout restart deployment/cache-invalidation-worker -n services && redis-cli info
preconditions: Verify consumer deployment manifest exists in namespace 'services'

REBUILD_DATABASE_INDEX.name: Rebuild Missing Database Index Concurrently
REBUILD_DATABASE_INDEX.description: Execute asynchronous CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY to restore missing query index without locking database tables.
REBUILD_DATABASE_INDEX.risk_notes: Moderate transient I/O load during index building; completely eliminates table scans upon creation.
REBUILD_DATABASE_INDEX.reversibility: High — index can be dropped without table mutation.
REBUILD_DATABASE_INDEX.suggested_command: psql -c "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_customer_created ON orders (customer_id, created_at);"
preconditions: Confirm available disk space for index creation

THROTTLE_TRAFFIC.name: Apply API Gateway Rate Limiting & Load Shedding
THROTTLE_TRAFFIC.description: Enable selective ingress throttling and rate-limiting to shed load from degraded backend tiers.
THROTTLE_TRAFFIC.risk_notes: Temporarily degrades client experience with HTTP 429 responses, but prevents total service outage.
preconditions: Verify ingress controller supports dynamic rate-limit patching

RESTART_CACHE.name: Flush & Restart Cache Cluster
RESTART_CACHE.description: Perform an immediate hard flush and restart of the cache cluster nodes.
RESTART_CACHE.risk_notes: Causes immediate 100% cache stampede onto the database, risking total database collapse while queue consumer remains broken.
RESTART_CACHE.reversibility: Irreversible — completely purges warm cache entries in memory.
preconditions: Confirm database can withstand immediate 100% cache miss load

FAILOVER_DATABASE.name: Trigger Database Replica Failover
FAILOVER_DATABASE.description: Force promotion of secondary database replica to primary instance.
FAILOVER_DATABASE.risk_notes: High operational risk, connection drops during DNS switch, potential data loss if replica has lag, and leaves the cache invalidation root cause untouched.
FAILOVER_DATABASE.reversibility: Low — requires manual database reprovisioning and resynchronization.
preconditions: Verify read replica replication lag is zero
Confirm primary database is truly unrecoverable
